items.title: Silver for record-breaking swimmer Richards
items.content_text: Matt Richards has created Wales swimming history by winning a fourth Commonwealth medal at one Games.  Richards, 23, claimed silver in the 200m freestyle alongside James Guy after the Englishman recorded the same time with Australian Kai Taylor taking the gold.  Only Valerie Davies in the first Games in 1930 and Michael Richards and Martyn Woodroffe 40 years later had previously managed three medals in one Games.
